title: Vehicle Fitting Type
description: One fitting type under fittings/. The first release only ships tracks ("type": "track"): the type id is the file name, fields are flat at the top level, and the visual is a sibling object. Material is a hard dependency: a missing or unknown material keeps the type out of the registry.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation.

type.description: Fitting kind. The first release only accepts "track"; any other value is a content pack error and the type is not registered.

material.description: Track material id; it must exist in the material registry (builtin ships machine_max:track_steel). It drives armor, contact friction, slip adaptation and block damage. A missing material keeps the type out of the registry.

thickness_mm.description: Link thickness in millimeters. It feeds armor RHA (thickness_mm x RHA coefficient) and the envelope offset; assembly requires it to stay below every member wheel radius.

durability_per_link.description: Durability per link (points). The whole belt's maximum durability is durability_per_link x link count.

length_per_link.description: Link length in meters. It derives the link count from the envelope perimeter and sets the spacing used when placing links while rendering.

overwrite.description: Material overwrite layered on top of material, merged with the same rules as hit boxes. Tracks only read physics and armor; overwrite.sounds has no effect on tracks (hit sounds come from this type's sounds).

physics.description: Physics overwrite: friction, slip, restitution and block damage.

friction.description: Anisotropic friction vector [x, y, z]. x = lateral, y = forward, z unused.

slip_adaptation.description: Wet slip adaptation used by the track contact wetFactor.

slip_curve.description: Tire slip curve overwrite. Tracks ignore this field.

block_damage_factor.description: Block damage energy factor; 0 means blocks cannot be destroyed.

armor.description: Armor overwrite: penetration resistance, damage reduction, durability decay and conditional modifiers.

rha.description: RHA coefficient relative to rolled homogeneous armor.

angle_effect.description: Whether effective thickness depends on the hit angle.

dmg_resist.description: Linear damage reduction, decaying with durability.

decay_rha.description: Residual RHA coefficient at zero durability.

decay_dmg_resist.description: Residual linear damage reduction at zero durability.

decay_dmg_mult.description: Residual damage multiplier at zero durability.

unpen_power.description: Damage exponent used when the hit does not penetrate.

sounds.description: Hit sound overwrite. No effect on tracks; track hit sounds come from this type's sounds.
Track hit sounds. Omitting the field uses two fixed-range hard_metal events; an empty object {} falls back to the hit box defaults hit_box.hit.*.

hit_un_pen.description: Sound played when the hit does not penetrate.

hit_pen.description: Sound played when the hit penetrates.

tension.description: One-sided spring-damper between adjacent member wheels. rest is sampled from the wheel centre distance at assembly / load time and is not declared here.

preload.description: Preload in meters, subtracted from rest.

slack.description: Slack in meters, added to rest; stretching below it applies no force.

max_force.description: Maximum tension per pair in N.

visual.description: Single-link model, model texture and inventory icon. model and texture are required. The model lives under the content pack's models/fitting/ and is loaded as ModelIndex("fitting", model).

model.description: Single-link model id, e.g. machine_max:track_link.geo (it points at models/fitting/track_link.geo.json, so the id keeps the .geo suffix). The namespace is the pack's namespace directory name, not the pack name.

texture.description: Full texture path for the model, e.g. machine_max:textures/part/track_link.png; the namespace is likewise the namespace directory name.

icon.description: Inventory 2D icon texture, e.g. machine_max:textures/icon/track_link.png; 128×128 with a transparent background is recommended. When omitted, the item and creative tab render the single-link 3D model instead.
